strings.多次重连失败，请检查网络后手动连接: Reconnecting failed several times. Check your network and connect manually

strings.密码至少 8 位: Password must be at least 8 characters

strings.已打开浏览器。若没有开始下载，可再点一次。: Browser opened. If the download didn't start, tap again.

strings.轻点下方按钮开始: Tap the button below to start
strings.还没有收到支付结果，请稍候: Payment not received yet, please wait
